concept.title: JSON_BINARY_FORMAT Query Option ( or higher only)

conbody.p: JSON_BINARY_FORMAT query option Specifies how BINARY column values are encoded in the data files of JSON tables, for tables that do not specify it with the json.binary.format serde property.

Impala has to know whether the binary data in a JSON table is base64 encoded or written as a raw string, otherwise it could return incorrect data. The format is taken from the first of these that is set:

ol.li: The json.binary.format serde property of the table or partition. The property takes precedence over the query option. If the property is set to a value other than base64 or rawstring, the query fails with an error instead of falling back to the query option.

conbody.p: If neither the property nor the query option is set, a query that scans a BINARY column of a JSON table fails with an error that names the table (and the partition, if the table is partitioned). Queries that do not scan a BINARY column of the table are not affected.
The valid values of the query option and of the serde property are:

ul.li: BASE64: the data is read as a base64 encoded string.
RAWSTRING: the data is read as a raw string.
NONE (the query option only): no format is set, which is the default.

conbody.p: Changes to the serde properties of a table take effect after a REFRESH of the table. The option can be set for all queries with the default_query_options startup flag of impalad.
